from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
repo = Path.cwd()
relative = 'skills/adversarial-review/scripts/review-lens-select.py'
baseline = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '8e8bcb4:' + relative])
after = (repo / relative).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='custom-agents-t14-')).resolve()
driver = root / '.bench' / 'review-lens-select.py'
driver.parent.mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8:replace')

def git(*args):
    subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=root, env=env, check=True, capture_output=True)

git('init', '-q', '-b', 'master')
git('config', 'user.email', 'fixture@example.invalid')
git('config', 'user.name', 'Fixture')
(root / '.git' / 'info' / 'exclude').write_text('.bench/\n.claude/\n', encoding='utf-8')
(root / 'README.md').write_text('fixture\n', encoding='utf-8')
git('add', 'README.md')
git('commit', '-qm', 'fixture base')
(root / '.claude').mkdir()
(root / '.claude' / 'dev.json').write_text(json.dumps({'revision': {'excluir': ['src/f0008.py']}}), encoding='utf-8')
files = []
for i in range(1081):
    rel = f'src/f{i:04}.py'
    path = root / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = ('"""Monta el prompt para el modelo."""\n'
              'profile = open(".claude/personas/backend.md").read()\n'
              'for item in items:\n    await fetch(item)\n'
              'sleep(1)\n' + '# UTF-8: \u00e1\U0001f680\n' * 20)
    content = source.encode('utf-8') if i % 29 else b'\x00binary\n'
    path.write_bytes(content)
    files.append(rel)

receipt = {'schema_version': 1, 'task': 'T-14', 'date': '2026-10-30',
    'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': platform.python_version(),
    'baseline_ref': '8e8bcb4219afbeae4e9f8cbe29a23a843e660cca',
    'source_lf_sha256': {k: hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k, v in [('before', baseline), ('after', after)]},
    'fixture': {'files': 1081, 'bytes': sum((root / p).stat().st_size for p in files),
                'binary_files': sum(i % 29 == 0 for i in range(1081)), 'location': 'Windows temporary filesystem, outside OneDrive',
                'description': 'UTF-8 prompt header, consumer read, loop/await and sleep; every 29th file binary; one explicit exclusion'},
    'method': 'Same disposable root and script path; replace source per run; 1 discarded warmup and 10 samples per variant/mode; rotate before/after/empty-python control order; compare complete JSON and stderr for each before/after pair.',
    'limits': ['Not the original 38-second host measurement', 'No native client activation or OneDrive claim', 'Temporary fixture retained for reproducibility; no production configuration touched'], 'modes': {}}

for mode in ['files', 'untracked', 'tracked']:
    if mode == 'tracked':
        git('add', 'src')
        git('commit', '-qm', 'fixture changes')
    args = ['--files', *files] if mode == 'files' else ['--base', 'HEAD~1' if mode == 'tracked' else 'HEAD']
    samples = {'before': [], 'after': [], 'control': []}
    warmups = {}
    expected = None
    for iteration in range(-1, 10):
        order = ['before', 'after', 'control']
        turn = max(0, iteration) % 3
        order = order[turn:] + order[:turn]
        pair = {}
        for variant in order:
            if variant != 'control':
                driver.write_bytes(baseline if variant == 'before' else after)
            command = ([sys.executable, '-c', 'pass'] if variant == 'control' else
                       [sys.executable, str(driver), '--root', str(root), '--json', *args])
            start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
            assert run.returncode == 0, (mode, variant, run.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
            if variant != 'control':
                pair[variant] = (json.loads(run.stdout), run.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
            (warmups if iteration < 0 else samples)[variant] = elapsed if iteration < 0 else samples[variant] + [elapsed]
        assert pair['before'] == pair['after'], (mode, iteration, 'behavior mismatch')
        expected = pair['after'][0]
    medians = {k: statistics.median(v) for k, v in samples.items()}
    receipt['modes'][mode] = {'samples_ms': samples, 'discarded_warmup_ms': warmups,
        'median_ms': medians, 'reduction_percent': (1 - medians['after'] / medians['before']) * 100,
        'complete_json_equal_pairs': 11, 'stderr_equal_pairs': 11, 'errors': [],
        'result_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
        'result_summary': {k: expected[k] for k in ['lente_c', 'lente_d', 'ficheros', 'avisos']}}
    print(mode, json.dumps(receipt['modes'][mode]['median_ms']), flush=True)
    destination = repo / 'docs/roadmap/2026-10-27-plugin-optimization/testing/t14-paired-control-2026-10-30.json'
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
(repo / '.pytest_cache/t14-benchmark-state.json').write_text(json.dumps({'fixture_root': str(root)}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print('complete', flush=True)
